name: midiflow
description: Turn MIDI into audio with the instruments and effects on your Mac, right from the chat.

output_dir.title: midiflow folder
output_dir.description: Where midiflow keeps what you export and your sample libraries, in its folders Projects and Instruments (default ~/Music/midiflow).

extra_plugin_dirs.title: Extra plug-in folder
extra_plugin_dirs.description: An additional folder with VST3 plug-ins.

allowed_input_dirs.title: Allowed input folder
allowed_input_dirs.description: A folder midiflow may read MIDI files and presets from, besides your project folders.

instrument_dirs.title: Instrument folder
instrument_dirs.description: A folder with sample libraries for the midiflow Sampler (SFZ, SoundFont, DecentSampler), besides the Instruments folder in your midiflow folder.

preferred_format.title: Preferred plug-in format
preferred_format.description: vst3 or au: used when a plug-in is installed in both formats (default vst3).

max_parallel_renders.title: Parallel renders
max_parallel_renders.description: How many renders may run at the same time, 1 to 4 (default 1).

note_name_convention.title: Note name display
note_name_convention.description: C4=60 or C3=60, display only; input always uses C4 = 60.

overload_mode.title: When a sound is too loud
overload_mode.description: lower (default): midiflow turns the whole recording down just enough that nothing clips, and tells you by how much. float: the file keeps the original level as a 32-bit float WAV for your DAW; players that cannot play float files will clip it.
